statement: Newegg lists the PNY NVIDIA H100 80 GB PCIe card at $34,879.00, with other seller options from $29,500.00; a static level with no baseline or prior price stated.
why: Retail and marketplace asking prices for last-generation data-center cards are the visible edge of the secondary hardware market, useful as a level reference even without a stated change.

impact.mechanism: Display overlay only: a listed hardware price with no stated baseline shows where asking prices sit but implies no direction for demand or supply.

evidence.excerpt: PNY NVIDIA H100 Graphic Card, 80 GB HBM3 - PCIe 5.0 x16 - 2 Slot - Passive: Price $34,879.00, with More options from $29,500.00 - $34,879.00.

confidence.basis: Marketplace listing page read directly, but asking prices from third-party sellers are not transacted prices and a single retail page is a thin sample.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 30999.0 -> 34879.0 (tol 1%); sources: Newegg
entity: Newegg marketplace listings (PNY, Supermicro, NVIDIA H100 NVL)
